dogecoin.text:
4/
DOGE has no cap on its supply because apparently, the world can't get enough of Shiba Inus. Thanks to social media and the occasional tweet from Elon Musk. But hey, in a world of serious crypto, Dogecoin's here to remind us that sometimes, it's good to just have fun.

3/
The Dogecoin community, or "Shibes," are like the Avengers of charity. Funded everything from the Jamaican bobsled to clean water in Kenya. It's like if Robin Hood decided to trade his bow for a blockchain. "Do Only Good Everyday"? More like "Do Only Good, Even If It's Silly."

2/ 
Dogecoin started as a Bitcoin parody because, let's face it, who wouldn't want a currency with a dog as its face? Launched in 2013 by two guys probably laughing at how far this would go, DOGE has become the internet's favorite underdog (or should we say, under-dogecoin?).
Dogecoin: From Internet Joke to Crypto Phenomenon https://t.co/NcdtU2qqA8
